name: Hikma Health Inc
mission: Hikma Health creates free and open source digital health solutions for clinics caring for refugees, migrants, and low-income patients.
programs: Hikma Health Electronic Health Record (EHR) System Deployment
theoryOfChange: Hikma Health utilizes a Health & Environmental Record System (HERS) which provides data analytics and modeling tools to empower data-driven decision making at individual, clinic, population, and environmental levels. The HERS system integrates fragmented health and environmental data streams, uses predictive analytics to identify patterns and forecast outbreaks, and provides smart alerts for high-risk patients. This approach is described with flowcharts illustrating how the system helps doctors provide targeted care and aids health systems and governments in planning and policy decisions to improve public health and support at-risk groups. Additionally, Hikma Health states they use an implementation science framework to understand the real-world application of their system across various clinical and cultural settings.
